quranTranslation.text: The good deed and the evil deed are not alike. Repel the evil deed with one which is better, then lo! he, between whom and thee there was enmity (will become) as though he was a bosom friend.

explanation.bs: „Uzvrati onim što je ljepše, i eto – onaj između koga i tebe je neprijateljstvo bit će kao prisan prijatelj.“
explanation.en: “Repel the evil deed with one which is better, then lo! he, between whom and thee there was enmity (will become) as though he was a bosom friend.”

quranTranslation.text: Satan seeketh only to cast among you enmity and hatred by means of strong drink and games of chance, and to turn you from remembrance of Allah and from (His) worship. Will ye then have done?

explanation.bs: „Šejtan samo želi da pomoću vina i kocke posije među vama neprijateljstvo i mržnju“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Satan seeketh only to cast among you enmity and hatred by means of strong drink and games of chance” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Take not for intimates others than your own folk, who would spare no pains to ruin you; they love to hamper you. Hatred is revealed by (the utterance of) their mouths, but that which their breasts hide is greater. We have made plain for you the revelations if ye will understand.

explanation.bs: „Iz njihovih usta već je izbila mržnja, a ono što skrivaju u grudima još je veće.“
explanation.en: “Hatred is revealed by (the utterance of) their mouths, but that which their breasts hide is greater.”

quranTranslation.text: There is a goodly pattern for you in Abraham and those with him, when they told their folk: Lo! we are guiltless of you and all that ye worship beside Allah. We have done with you. And there hath arisen between us and you hostility and hate for ever until ye believe in Allah only - save that which Abraham promised his father (when he said): I will ask forgiveness for thee, though I own nothing for thee from Allah - Our Lord! In Thee we put our trust, and unto Thee we turn repentant, and unto Thee is the journeying.

explanation.bs: Ibrahim i oni s njim svom narodu: „Među nama i vama ukazalo se neprijateljstvo i mržnja za vječna vremena – sve dok ne povjerujete u Allaha Jedinog.“
explanation.en: Abraham and those with him to their people: “And there hath arisen between us and you hostility and hate for ever until ye believe in Allah only.”

quranTranslation.text: O man! What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful,

explanation.bs: „O čovječe, šta te to obmanulo glede tvoga plemenitog Gospodara?“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet; obmana kao nemar.
explanation.en: “O man! What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah; ġarra here is ‘made careless’.

quranTranslation.text: They will cry unto them (saying): Were we not with you? They will say: Yea, verily; but ye tempted one another, and hesitated, and doubted, and vain desires beguiled you till the ordinance of Allah came to pass; and the deceiver deceived you concerning Allah;

explanation.bs: Licemjerima se kaže da su ih zanijele puste želje i da ih je Varalica obmanuo u pogledu Allaha – obmana kroz želje, ne kroz nečiji plan.
explanation.en: The hypocrites are told that vain wishes deluded them and that the Deluder deluded them about Allah — delusion through wishes, not through someone's plan.

quranTranslation.text: And if they would deceive thee, then lo! Allah is Sufficient for thee. He it is Who supporteth thee with His help and with the believers,

explanation.bs: „Ako su naumili da te prevare – Allah ti je, zaista, sasvim dovoljan …“ – plan druge strane; zaštita je u Allahu, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “And if they would deceive thee, then lo! Allah is Sufficient for thee” — the other side's plan; the protection is in Allah, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! the hypocrites seek to beguile Allah, but it is He Who beguileth them. When they stand up to worship they perform it languidly and to be seen of men, and are mindful of Allah but little;

explanation.bs: Licemjeri nastoje prevariti Allaha, a On je ḫādiʿuhum – ar-Rāġib prenosi dva tumačenja: kažnjava ih za prevaru, ili kao u 3:54 (oni su snovali, a i Allah je snovao), kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: The hypocrites try to deceive Allah, and it is He who is ḫādiʿuhum — ar-Rāġib reports two readings: He requites them for their deceit, or it is as in 3:54 (they plotted and Allah plotted), as befits Him.
